negative.name: taken-continuing-branch-refuses-later-read
negative.reason: Deleting only the terminal return leaves a continuing branch where the whole owned Token has been transferred. The later observe(item) is a possible use-after-take and must preserve E2S123 before capture publication.

negative.name: mutable-nominal-record-explicit
negative.reason: A task-local whole nominal Token binding is mutable despite its explicit type. Preserve the existing Stage 2 immutable-record binding boundary as E2S32 before capture filtering/publication.

negative.name: mutable-nominal-record-inferred
negative.reason: An inferred Token constructor does not permit a mutable nominal record binding. Require the same E2S32 as the explicitly typed counterpart, even though the receiver is task-local.

negative.name: mutable-callable-reassignment
negative.reason: The selected callable profile resolves immutable declarations and does not track mutable function values. Refuse a mutable callable binding/reassignment even with the same Int-to-Int signature; do not apply the initializer signature or silently omit the reassigned body. Immutable callable controls remain positive.

negative.name: duplicate-top-level-function
negative.reason: Duplicate top-level functions cannot establish a unique checked callee; preserve the existing E2S16 refusal.

negative.name: unused-undeclared-formal-type
negative.reason: An unused formal still requires a declared source type; capturing a different valid formal must not hide Missing. Preserve E2S15.

negative.name: callable-actual-wrong-domain
negative.reason: The actual lambda body is valid Int, but its sole parameter is Bool rather than the required Int. Coarse Fn classification must not satisfy the fixed Int-to-Int formal signature.

negative.name: callable-actual-wrong-result
negative.reason: The actual lambda has the required Int parameter but a valid Bool body result, not the formal Int result. The shared block-lambda positive prevents blanket argument-lambda refusal from satisfying this signature check.

negative.name: callable-actual-wrong-arity
negative.reason: The actual lambda has a valid Int result and two Int parameters, while the formal requires exactly one. Callable arity is fixed; do not accept the coarse Fn type or invent currying/partial application.

negative.name: lambda-after-take
negative.reason: The ordinary lambda is created after item was transferred. Its latent body must inherit the enclosing unavailable-binding fact and preserve E2S123 even though the callable is never invoked and there are no task captures.

negative.name: task-local-lambda-after-take
negative.reason: A task-local item was transferred before the nested lambda was created. Inheriting the enclosing moved state must produce E2S123 before local-base capture exclusion can hide the invalid latent read.

negative.name: spawn-after-parent-take
negative.reason: The parent transferred item before creating the spawn lambda. The task body cannot reset that known moved state and must refuse its read as E2S123, without claiming future parent/task conflict analysis.
